summary: A four-day reconnaissance campaign (Feb 22-25, 2026) generated 84,142 sessions from 4,305 IPs against exposed SonicWall SonicOS firewalls, with 92% of traffic probing the SSL VPN status-check API to build a target list for later credential attacks. Activity was delivered by four infrastructure clusters, including a commercial proxy service (ByteZero) that supplied 27,119 sessions from 4,102 rotating exit IPs and a single mega-scanner cycling 26 user agents. Detection should focus on management/VPN endpoint URIs, the HTTP/1.0-with-modern-Chrome-UA mismatch, and the listed scanning infrastructure ranges.
